conventions.slotRequirement.sizeUnits: internal: CubeSat U (fractions of 0.25 allowed). external: mounting-face units (1 = one full face, 0.25 = a quarter face).
conventions.secondarySlot: Optional second mount a part also needs (e.g. radio unit behind an antenna, camera aperture window, thruster nozzle).
conventions.massKg: Dry hardware mass. Propellant (fuelMassKg) is added on top for wet mass.
conventions.solarFormula: P = powerSunW * cos(theta_sun) while in sunlight

components.name: 1U CubeSat Chassis
components.description: Entry-level 1U structure. Tiny power and mass budget; suited to technology demos and simple relays.

components.name: 3U CubeSat Chassis
components.description: Workhorse 3U structure with extended lateral faces for body-mounted or deployable arrays.

components.name: 6U CubeSat Chassis
components.description: Double-width CubeSat bus. Smallest chassis able to host a real Earth-observation camera plus ADCS and a high-rate radio.

components.name: 12U CubeSat Chassis
components.description: Large CubeSat class bus. Room for a high-resolution imager, electric propulsion and large deployable arrays.

components.name: SmallSat Bus
components.description: Proper microsatellite platform with eight equipment bays, articulated arrays and mid-power payloads such as SAR.

components.name: Heavy LEO Bus
components.description: Flagship LEO platform with twelve modular bays. Carries kilowatt-class power, large SAR and heavy propulsion.

components.name: Body-Mounted Si Cells (1U face)
components.description: Silicon cells bonded to one 10x10 cm face. Zero moving parts and zero added drag.

components.name: Body-Mounted Si Cells (3U face)
components.description: Silicon cells covering one 10x30 cm lateral face.

components.name: Body-Mounted GaAs Cells (3U face)
components.description: Triple-junction GaAs on a lateral face. Highest power available without deploying anything.

components.name: Body-Mounted GaAs Cells (6U face)
components.description: Triple-junction GaAs covering a 20x30 cm face.

components.name: Body-Mounted Si Panel (SmallSat)
components.description: Large silicon panel on a SmallSat face. Reliable baseline power with no drag penalty.

components.name: Deployable Si Wing 20W
components.description: Two-panel deployable silicon wing. Cheap mid-power option; adds drag once deployed.

components.name: Deployable Si Wing 30W
components.description: Three-panel deployable silicon wing, a typical port or starboard array.

components.name: Deployable GaAs Wing 30W
components.description: Light deployable GaAs wing: same power as silicon in about two thirds of the area.

components.name: Deployable GaAs Wing 45W
components.description: Three-panel GaAs wing. Strong power-to-mass ratio for imaging CubeSats.

components.name: Deployable GaAs Wing 80W
components.description: Large fixed deployable GaAs wing for 12U and SmallSat classes.

components.name: Gimbaled GaAs Wing 60W
components.description: Single-axis Sun-tracking wing sized for 12U buses. Tracking raises orbit-average power.

components.name: Articulated Dual-Wing GaAs 120W
components.description: Dual-wing Sun-tracking GaAs array. Uses two opposing faces.

components.name: Articulated Dual-Wing GaAs 300W
components.description: High-power tracking array for SAR or electric propulsion on SmallSat and Heavy buses.

components.name: Articulated Dual-Wing GaAs 600W
components.description: Large Heavy-bus array for sustained high-duty payloads.

components.name: Articulated Dual-Wing GaAs 1200W
components.description: Kilowatt-class array. Large drag area and a significant mass penalty.

components.name: Li-Ion CubeSat Pack 20Wh
components.description: Smallest pack. Barely survives an eclipse for a low-power CubeSat.

components.name: Li-Ion CubeSat Pack 50Wh
components.description: Standard 1U pack and the Level 1 default.

components.name: Li-Ion CubeSat Pack 80Wh
components.description: High-density 1U pack for burst-heavy payloads.

components.name: Li-Ion Pack 160Wh
components.description: Double-volume pack. Good fit for imaging plus X-band burst downlinks.

components.name: Li-Ion Pack 320Wh
components.description: Large Li-ion pack for SmallSat operations through long eclipses.

components.name: Solid-State Pack 250Wh
components.description: Solid-state cells: deeper usable discharge and better thermal tolerance.

components.name: Solid-State Pack 500Wh
components.description: Mid-size aerospace pack for sustained radar or electric propulsion burns.

components.name: Solid-State Pack 1000Wh
components.description: High-capacity pack for high-duty payloads.

components.name: Solid-State Pack 2000Wh
components.description: Heavy-bus pack that sustains SAR and Hall thrusters through full eclipses.

components.name: RGB Micro-Imager (1U)
components.description: Small Earth camera with coarse ground resolution. Loose pointing needs and a low data rate.

components.name: Urban Optical Imager (3U)
components.description: Level 1 stock camera with three focal-length settings. Longer focal length sharpens GSD but costs mass and power. At 500 km, 5 um pixels and f=1.0 m give 2.5 m GSD and a 15 km swath.

components.name: Wide-Swath RGB Imager (2U)
components.description: Line-scan camera trading resolution for a very wide swath and short revisit.

components.name: High-Resolution RGB Imager (4U)
components.description: Long focal-length telescope for sub-3 m imagery over a narrow swath. Needs a precise ADCS.

components.name: Dual-Band Crop Imager (2U)
components.description: Cheap red + near-infrared imager built for NDVI vegetation indices.

components.name: Multispectral Imager (3U)
components.description: Four-band imager (blue, green, red, NIR). Needs tight pointing and produces large data volumes.

components.name: Hyperspectral Imaging Spectrometer (6U)
components.description: Over 100 narrow bands for crop stress and mineral mapping. Heavy, power-hungry and data-hungry.

components.name: Low-Light Night Imager (2U)
components.description: Sensitive night-time sensor for city lights and power-outage mapping after disasters.

components.name: Thermal IR Imager (3U)
components.description: Uncooled microbolometer for wildfires and flood extent. Works day or night with coarse resolution.

components.name: C-Band SAR (SmallSat)
components.description: All-weather day/night radar. Huge instantaneous power draw means a strict duty cycle.

components.name: X-Band SAR (Heavy)
components.description: High-resolution X-band radar. Needs kilowatt-class power, a Heavy bus and large storage.

components.name: AIS / IoT Marine Tracking Relay (1U)
components.description: Omnidirectional receiver for ship and sensor beacons. Low power, continuous duty.

components.name: ADS-B Aircraft Tracker (1U)
components.description: Space-based ADS-B receiver for global flight tracking.

components.name: Atmospheric Trace-Gas Spectrometer (3U)
components.description: Measures CO2, methane and aerosols along the limb and nadir. Best from polar orbits.

components.name: Magnetorquer Detumble Set
components.description: Coil rods that damp tumbling and give very coarse pointing.

components.name: Reaction Wheel + Magnetorquer Pack
components.description: Three-axis wheels plus torque rods. Standard CubeSat 0.1 degree pointing.

components.name: Agile Reaction Wheel Pack
components.description: Fast-slewing wheel set for quick retargeting and off-nadir imaging.

components.name: Four-Wheel Pyramid Array
components.description: High-torque redundant array for SmallSat class pointing precision.

components.name: Control Moment Gyro Cluster
components.description: Heavy CMG cluster. Extremely precise and fast, with a heavy power cost.

components.name: Cold Gas Micro-Thruster 1U (N2)
components.description: Safe, cheap nitrogen thruster. Roughly 25 m/s of delta-v on a 6 kg 3U.

components.name: Cold Gas Micro-Thruster 2U (N2)
components.description: Double-size tank for longer station-keeping or a controlled de-orbit.

components.name: Pulsed Plasma Thruster
components.description: Solid PTFE electric thruster. Tiny thrust, good Isp, ideal for drag make-up on CubeSats.

components.name: Green Monopropellant Thruster 1N
components.description: Non-toxic monoprop for CubeSat maneuvers and plane changes.

components.name: Hydrazine Monopropellant 1N
components.description: Classic monoprop thruster for orbit raising and collision avoidance on mid-size buses.

components.name: Hydrazine Monopropellant 5N
components.description: Higher-thrust hydrazine system for SmallSat transfers.

components.name: Hydrazine Monopropellant 20N
components.description: Heavy-bus thruster bank for rapid maneuvers.

components.name: Hall-Effect Xenon Thruster 100W
components.description: Compact Hall thruster. Very efficient but needs about 100 W while firing.

components.name: Hall-Effect Xenon Thruster 400W
components.description: Mid-power Hall thruster for SmallSat orbit changes.

components.name: Hall-Effect Xenon Thruster 1.3kW
components.description: High-power Hall thruster for efficient heavy-bus transfers.

components.name: UHF Deployable Whip
components.description: Omnidirectional tracking-and-command link. Needs no pointing but is very slow.

components.name: S-Band Patch Antenna
components.description: Flush patch with a 60 degree beam. Level 1 default link at 5 Mbps.

components.name: S-Band Patch Array
components.description: Four-element S-band array with more throughput and a narrower beam.

components.name: S-Band Horn Antenna
components.description: Directional S-band horn. Top of the S-band range, still far slower than X-band.

components.name: X-Band Patch Antenna
components.description: Low-gain X-band patch for CubeSats. 50 Mbps with a wide-ish 30 degree beam.

components.name: X-Band Steerable Dish
components.description: High-throughput steerable dish. Narrow 5 degree beam and a 0.5 degree ADCS lock requirement.

components.name: X-Band Phased Array
components.description: Electronically steered X-band array. Fast retargeting between ground stations.

components.name: Laser Optical Downlink Terminal
components.description: Gigabit-class optical downlink. Needs sub-0.1 degree pointing, so reaction wheels or CMGs are mandatory.

components.name: Basic OBC
components.description: Minimal flight computer with 512 MB of buffer.

components.name: Standard OBC
components.description: Level 1 default. 4 GB of onboard flash.

components.name: Radiation-Tolerant OBC
components.description: Error-correcting computer with 16 GB buffer and better radiation resistance.

components.name: Radiation-Hardened OBC
components.description: Fully hardened flight computer with 64 GB buffer.

components.name: Solid-State Recorder 16GB
components.description: Compact data recorder for short imaging passes.

components.name: Solid-State Recorder 64GB
components.description: Mid-size recorder. Holds several orbits of multispectral data.

components.name: Radiation-Hardened Recorder 32GB
components.description: Hardened memory. Safer for radiation-upset events.

components.name: Solid-State Recorder 256GB
components.description: High-capacity recorder for SmallSat and radar.

components.name: Solid-State Recorder 1TB
components.description: Terabyte-class buffer.

components.name: Solid-State Recorder 4TB
components.description: Heavy-bus mass memory for continuous SAR operations.

components.name: Onboard Compression Coprocessor
components.description: Compresses imagery 2.5x before storage and downlink, effectively stretching both.

components.name: MLI Blanket Kit (CubeSat)
components.description: Multi-layer insulation that cuts heat loss during eclipse.

components.name: MLI Blanket Kit (Large)
components.description: Full-bus insulation wrap for larger platforms.

components.name: Radiator Panel 3U
components.description: Passive radiator on a 3U lateral face.

components.name: Radiator Panel 6U
components.description: Passive radiator on a 20x30 cm face.

components.name: Deployable Radiator 12U
components.description: Folding radiator with extra effective area.

components.name: Radiator Panel SmallSat
components.description: Large passive radiator for SmallSat payload waste heat.

components.name: Radiator Panel Heavy
components.description: One square meter of passive radiator for high-power payloads.

components.name: Variable-Emissivity Louver Radiator
components.description: Louvers close in eclipse to hold heat and open in sunlight to shed it.

components.name: Loop Heat Pipe Radiator
components.description: Pumped loop moves payload heat to the radiator. Handles radar-class loads.

components.name: Kapton Heater 5W
components.description: Thin-film heater for cold electronics in eclipse.

components.name: Ceramic Heater 15W
components.description: Mid-power heater for batteries and payload bays.

components.name: Ceramic Heater 40W
components.description: High-power heater for large payloads.

components.name: Zoned Heater Bank 100W
components.description: Multi-zone heater bank for SmallSat and Heavy payload cold soaks.
